census.mass_floor_note: plan quotes 9.5e10 = 0.03 x 10^12.5 rounded up; 9.4e10 keeps every mu >= 0.03 overlapper of a 10^12.5 central

extraction.bytes_per_particle_note: radii234 112 (fields + 8 B membership) + StarFormationRates 4 + XrayLuminosities float64[3] 24
extraction.star_forming: StarFormationRates > 0 (dataset description: positive = SFR, negative = -last SF scale factor, 0 = never)

politeness.note: maas is a shared host without a scheduler: read-only access to /net/hypernova; all writes inside this study directory; every remote job runs at nice 19 and best-effort I/O priority 7; the particle pass sizes its pool from the live load

RLIMIT_AS_note: virtual address-space cap per worker; G6 (file 56, reopen every 16 cells, fixed mmap threshold) peaked at 1.52 GiB RSS / 1.90 GiB VMS, so 8 GiB is a 4x backstop; resident memory is guarded by RSS_stop_GiB and the system free-memory floor
chunk_cache_note: largest dataset chunk is 36 MiB (SmoothedElementMassFractions); 80 MiB raised the open-file footprint
malloc_env_note: fixed mmap threshold: freed HDF5 decompression buffers return to the OS; with it, a worker drops to 0.7 GiB after closing a file versus 1.5 GiB without (memory_diagnostic.json)
